study_identification_part.si_4_title: GPT- based normative models of brain sMRI correlate with dimensional psychopathology

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Brazilian High-Risk Cohort Study (BHRCS); Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD); Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD-200); Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange II (ABIDE-II).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The studied datasets contain measures of dimensional psychopathology: Brazilian High- Risk Cohort Study (BHRCS, n = 737) and Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD, n = 11,031), and scores and diagnostic of psychiatric disorders: Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD- 200, n = 922) and Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange II (ABIDE- II, n = 580)."

answer.ABCD: training/validation and test split (normative model development and evaluation)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: ABCD subjects split into training (n=6,756), validation (n=751), and testing (n=3,524); ABIDE-II, ADHD-200, and BHRCS datasets fully reserved for evaluation (final tests).
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "The subjects of ABCD were split into three sets for training ( n= 6,756), validation ( n= 751), and testing ( n= 3,524) purposes... The ABCD test set ( n= 3,524) and the complete datasets of ABIDE-II ( n= 580), ADHD-200 ( n= 922), and BHRCS ( n= 737) were reserved for the evaluation procedure (i.e., final tests)."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Overall-phase counts reflect ABCD training+validation (6,756 + 751 = 7,507) derived from the ABCD split; training-phase uses 6,756. These are the typical-subject sets used for model development.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "The subjects of ABCD were split into three sets for training ( n= 6,756), validation ( n= 751), and testing ( n= 3,524) purposes... The purpose of reserving all high CBCL subjects for test sets is because the models are normative, trained exclusively with TD subjects."

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Age statistics are reported for the ABCD dataset overall (mean 9.9 years, SD 0.6). Age statistics for the specific training subset were not reported.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Overall-phase sex ratio is from the ABCD dataset (male 52.0%); female percentage inferred as 48.0% with counts inferred from N=11,031. Sex stats for the training subset were not reported.
